title: Ice Cream and Candy Land: Coloring Book for Kids Ages 4-8, Bold and Easy
subtitle: 50 Sweet Treat Designs with Cupcakes, Lollipops, Donuts, and Fun Dessert Illustrations for Young Children
description:
Welcome to the sweetest coloring adventure your little one will ever have!


This yummy coloring book is a candy-colored dream come true for kids who love sweet treats. Each page features a big, bold, and easy-to-color illustration of everyone's favorite desserts — towering ice cream sundaes, swirly lollipops, frosted cupcakes, sprinkle-covered donuts, gummy bears, cotton candy, and so much more. Every design is simple, centered, and perfectly sized for little hands to color with crayons, markers, or colored pencils.

What's Inside:
• 50 adorable sweet treat illustrations with thick, bold outlines
• Ice cream cones, cupcakes, lollipops, donuts, candy, cake pops, and gummy bears
• Simple, big designs that fill the page — perfect for small hands
• Single-sided pages to prevent bleed-through
• Large 8.5 x 8.5 inch pages — plenty of room to color
• Great for crayons, colored pencils, and markers

Perfect For:
• Kids ages 4-8 who love candy and desserts
• A sweet birthday, holiday, or Easter basket gift
• Quiet creative time at home, school, or on road trips
• Building fine motor skills and sparking imagination

Hand your little one their favorite crayons and let the sweet coloring fun begin!
